items.text: Linux panes drop onto the tab bar, and a 500ms rest on a tab opens it mid-drag.
A Linux pane dragged into another window splits, swaps or becomes a tab there, and a window's last pane may leave it.
The release step's link rewriter retargets the site's Setup download once the page offers one.
A Linux pane drag carries a ghost card of the pane under the pointer.
WIP: the pane-drag --ghost report writes its colours as number arrays.
A Linux pane drag carries a ghost card of the pane, proven headless.
A Linux pane let go over nothing, or its header's new button, opens it in a window of its own.
The desktop-launch audit now sees camelCase exe names like $testExe, so a test that starts the app under one cannot slip past it.
